title: senderDisplayName has no fallback when ChatContact not yet resolved
description: The spec says senderDisplayName is 'Derived from ChatContact.displayName if present, otherwise ChatContact.login.' In federated deployments a message can arrive via Peer/deliver before the receiving server has populated the sender's ChatContact record. Neither displayName nor login may be available. The spec needs an explicit fallback to senderId so the field is always resolvable at push-generation time.
